mn83:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Mithilāyaṃ viharati Makhādevambavane.
mn83:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā aññatarasmiṃ padese sitaṃ patvākāsi.
mn83:2.2: Atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi:
mn83:2.3: Ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo Bhagavato sitassa pātukammāya?
mn83:2.5: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena Bhagavā ten' añjalim paṇāmetvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn83:2.6: Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo Bhagavato sitassa pātukammāya?
mn83:3.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ, Ānanda, imissā yeva Mithilāyaṃ rājā ahosi Makhādevo nāma dhammiko dhammarājā dhamme ṭhito mahārājā
mn83:3.2: dhammaṃ carati brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu c' eva jānapadesu ca,
mn83:3.3: uposathañ ca upavasati cātuddasiṃ pañcaddasiṃ aṭṭhamiñ ca pakkhassa.
mn83:4.1: Atha kho, Ānanda, rājā Makhādevo bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena kappakaṃ āmantesi:
mn83:4.2: Yadā me, samma kappaka, passeyyāsi sirasmiṃ phalitāni jātāni, atha me āroceyyāsīti.
mn83:4.3: Evaṃ devāti kho, Ānanda, kappako rañño Makhādevassa paccassosi.
mn83:4.4: Addasā kho, Ānanda, kappako bahunnaṃ vassānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasatānaṃ bahunnaṃ vassasahassānaṃ accayena rañño Makhādevassa sirasmiṃ phalitāni jātāni,
mn83:4.6: Pātubhūtā kho devassa devadūtā; dissanti sirasmiṃ phalitāni jātānīti.
mn83:4.7: Tena hi, samma kappaka, tāni phalitāni sādhukaṃ saṇḍāsena uddharitvā mamaṃ añjalismiṃ patiṭṭhāpehīti.
mn83:4.8: Evaṃ devāti kho, Ānanda, kappako rañño Makhādevassa paṭisutvā tāni phalitāni sādhukaṃ saṇḍāsena uddharitvā rañño Makhādevassa añjalismiṃ patiṭṭhāpesī.
mn83:4.9: Atha kho, Ānanda, rājā Makhādevo kappakassa gāmavaraṃ datvā jeṭṭhaputtaṃ kumāraṃ āmantāpetvā etad avoca:
mn83:4.10: Pātubhūtā kho me, tāta kumāra, devadūtā,
mn83:4.12: Bhuttā kho pana me mānusakā kāmā;
mn83:4.14: Ehi tvaṃ, tāta kumāra, imaṃ rajjaṃ paṭipajja;
mn83:4.15: ahaṃ pana kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmi.
mn83:4.16: Tena hi, tāta kumāra, yadā tvam pi passeyyāsi sirasmiṃ phalitāni jātāni, atha kappakassa gāmavaraṃ datvā jeṭṭhaputtaṃ kumāraṃ sādhukaṃ rajje samanusāsitvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyāsi.
mn83:4.17: Yena me idaṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ anuppavatteyyāsi mā kho me tvaṃ antimapuriso ahosi.
mn83:4.18: Yasmiṃ kho, tāta kumāra, purisayuge vattamāne evarūpassa kalyāṇassa vaṭṭassa samucchedo hoti, so tesaṃ antimapuriso hoti.
mn83:4.19: Tan tāhaṃ, tāta kumāra, evaṃ vadāmi:
mn83:4.20: Yena me idaṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ anuppavatteyyāsi, mā kho me tvaṃ antimapuriso ahosīti.
mn83:5.1: Atha kho. Ānanda, rājā Makhādevo kappakassa gāmavaraṃ datvā jeṭṭhaputtaṃ kumāraṃ sādhukaṃ rajje samanusāsitvā imasmiṃ yeva Makhādevambavane kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji.
mn83:5.2: So mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihāsi, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ; iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā vihāsi.
mn83:5.5: upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihāsi, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catuṭṭhiṃ; iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā vihāsi.
mn83:6.1: Rājā kho pan', Ānanda. Makhādevo caturāsītivassasahassāni kumārakīḷikaṃ kīḷi; caturāsītivassasahassāni oparajjaṃ kāresi; caturāsītivassasahassāni rajjaṃ kāresi; caturāsītivassasahassāni imasmiṃ yeva Makhādevambavane agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito brahmacariyaṃ cari.
mn83:6.2: So cattāro brahmavihāre bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā brahmalokūpago ahosi.

mn83:7.5: disvā rañño Makhādevassa puttaṃ etad avoca:
mn83:7.8: Tena hi, samma kappaka, tāni phalitāni sādhukaṃ saṇḍāsena uddharitvā mama añjalismiṃ patiṭṭhāpehīti.
mn83:7.9: Evaṃ devāti kho. Ānanda, kappako rañño Makhādevassa puttassa paṭisutvā tāni phalitāni sādhukaṃ saṇḍāsena uddharitvā rañño Makhādevassa puttassa añjalismiṃ patiṭṭhāpesi.

mn83:10.1: Rañño kho pan', Ānanda, Makhādevassa puttapaputtakā tassa paramparā caturāsītikhattiyasahassāni imasmiṃ yeva Makhādevambavane kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagārīyaṃ pabbajiṃsu.
mn83:10.2: Te mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihariṃsu, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ; iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā vihariṃsu,
mn83:11.3: upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihariṃsu, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ; iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā vihariṃsu. Te
mn83:11.4: caturāsītivassasahassāni kumārakīḷikaṃ kīḷiṃsu, caturāsītivassasahassāni oparajjaṃ kāresuṃ, caturāsītivassasahassāni rajjaṃ kāresuṃ, caturāsītivassasahassāni imasmiṃ Makhādevambavane agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā brahmacariṃ cariṃsu.

mn83:12.1: Nimi tesaṃ rājānaṃ pacchimako ahosi dhammiko dhammarājā, dhamme ṭhito mahārājā,
mn83:12.2: dhammaṃ carati brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu c' eva jānapadesu ca,
mn83:12.3: uposathañ ca upavasati cātuddasiṃ pañcaddasiṃ aṭṭhamiñ ca pakkhassa.
mn83:13.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ, Ānanda , devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ Sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam antarākathā udapādi:
mn83:13.2: Lābhā vata bho Videhānaṃ, suladdhaṃ vata bho Videhānaṃ
mn83:13.3: yesaṃ Nimi rājā dhammiko dhammarājā dhamme ṭhito mahārājā
mn83:13.4: dhammaṃ carati brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu c' eva jānapadesu ca,
mn83:13.5: uposathañ ca upavasati cātuddasiṃ pañcaddasiṃ aṭṭhamiñ ca pakkhassāti.
mn83:13.6: Atha kho, Ānanda, Sakko devānam indo deve Tāvatiṃse āmantesi:
mn83:13.7: Iccheyyātha no tumhe mārisā Nimi-rājānaṃ daṭṭhun ti?
mn83:13.8: Icchāma mayaṃ mārisa Nimi-rājānaṃ daṭṭhun ti.
mn83:13.9: Tena kho pana samayena Nimirājā tadahu 'posathe pannarase sīsaṃ nahāto uposathiko upari pāsādavaragato nisinno hoti.
mn83:13.10: Atha kho, Ānanda, Sakko devānam indo seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva devesu Tāvatiṃsesu antarahito Nimissa rañño mukhe pāturahosi.
mn83:13.11: Atha kho, Ānanda, Sakko devānam indo Nimi-rājānaṃ etad avoca:
mn83:13.12: Lābhā te, mahārāja, suladdhaṃ te, mahārāja;
mn83:13.13: devā, mahārāja, Tāvatiṃsā Sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ kittayamānarūpā sannisinnā:
mn83:13.19: tassa te ahaṃ, mahārāja, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ pahiṇissāmi;
mn83:13.20: abhirūheyyāsi, mahārāja, dibbaṃ yānaṃ avikampamāno ti.
mn83:13.21: Adhivāsesi kho, Ānanda, Nimi rājā tuṇhībhāvena.
mn83:13.22: Atha kho, Ānanda, Sakko devānam indo Nimissa rañño adhivāsanaṃ viditvā seyyathāpi nāma . . . &c. as above . . . antarahito devesu Tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi.
mn83:14.1: Atha kho, Ānanda, Sakko devānam indo Mātali -- saṃgāhakaṃ āmantesi:
mn83:14.2: Ehi tvaṃ, samma Mātali, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā Nimi-rājānaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadesi:--
mn83:14.3: Ayan te, mahārāja, sahassayutto ājaññaratho Sakkena devānam indena pesito;
mn83:14.4: abhirūheyyāsi, mahārāja, dibbaṃ yānaṃ avikampamāno ti.
mn83:14.5: Evaṃ hotu bhaddan tavāti kho, Ānanda, Mātali saṃgāhako Sakkassa devānam indassa paṭisutvā sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā Nimi-rājānaṃ upasaṃkamitvā etad avoca:
mn83:14.6: Ayan te, mahārāja, sahassayutto ājaññaratho Sakkena devānam indena pesito;
mn83:14.8: Api ca, mahārāja, katamena taṃ nemi, -- yena vā pāpakammā pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, yena vā kalyāṇakammā kalyāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedentīti?
mn83:15.1: Sampāpesi kho, Ānanda, Mātali saṃgāhako Nimi-rājānaṃ Sudhammaṃ sabhaṃ.
mn83:15.2: Addasā kho. Ānanda, Sakko devānam indo Nimi-rājānaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ,
mn83:15.6: devā te, mahārāja, Tāvatiṃsā Sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ kittayamānarūpā sannisinnā:-Lābhā . . .
mn83:15.13: Alaṃ mārisa tatth' eva maṃ Mithilaṃ paṭinetu,
mn83:15.14: tatthāhaṃ dhammaṃ carissāmi brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu c' eva jānapadesu ca,
mn83:15.15: uposathañ ca upavasissāmi catuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ aṭṭhamiñ ca pakkhassāti.

mn83:21.1: Siyā kho pana te. Ānanda, evam assa:
mn83:21.2: Añño nūna tena, samayena rājā Makhādevo ahosi, yena taṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitan ti.
mn83:21.3: Na kho pan' etaṃ, Ānanda, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn83:21.4: Ahaṃ tena samayena rājā Makhādevo ahosiṃ;
mn83:21.5: ahan taṃ kalyāṇaṃ vattaṃ nihaniṃ; mayā taṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ;
mn83:21.7: Taṃ kho pan', Ānanda, kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvad eva brahmalokupapattiyā.
mn83:21.8: Idaṃ kho pan', Ānanda, etarahi mayā kalyāṇaṃ vattaṃ nihitaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
mn83:21.9: Katamā c', Ānanda, etarahi mayā kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati?
mn83:21.10: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathīdaṃ:
mn83:21.11: Sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṃkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
mn83:21.12: Idaṃ kho, Ānanda, etarahi mayā kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
mn83:21.13: Tam kho ahaṃ, Ānanda, evaṃ vadāmi:
mn83:21.14: Yena me idaṃ kalyāṇaṃ vattaṃ nihitaṃ anuppavatteyyātha, mā kho me tumhe antimapuriso ahuvattha.
mn83:21.15: Yasmiṃ kho, Ānanda, purisayuge vattamāne evarūpassa kalyāṇassa vaṭṭassa samucchedo hoti, so tesaṃ antimapuriso hoti.
mn83:21.16: Taṃ vo ahaṃ, Ānanda, evaṃ vadāmi:
mn83:21.17: Yena me idaṃ kalyāṇaṃ vaṭṭaṃ nihitaṃ anuppavatteyyātha, mā kho me tumhe antimapuriso ahuvatthāti.
mn83:21.19: Attamano āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 84.
